sentence: We made a colorful poster for our school concert.
trans: 我們為學校音樂會做了一張繽紛的海報。

sentence: The boy grinned happily when he won the board game.
trans: 小男孩贏了桌遊時高興地裂嘴而笑。

sentence: Let's read a funny book instead of watching television.
trans: 我們看本有趣的書，而不是看電視吧。

sentence: He built a wooden model airplane with his father.
trans: 他跟爸爸一起用木頭組裝了一架模型飛機。

sentence: She gave the bird a small handful of seeds.
trans: 她給了小鳥一小把穀物種子。

sentence: When it rained, the children felt a little bored inside.
trans: 下雨時，待在室內的孩子們感到有點無聊。

sentence: We spent the afternoon putting together a jigsaw puzzle.
trans: 我們花了整個下午拼拼圖。

sentence: The tired baby became grumpy before taking a nap.
trans: 疲憊的小寶寶在午睡前變得鬧彆扭脾氣暴躁。

sentence: He shuffled the deck of playing cards before the game.
trans: 他在遊戲開始前洗了整副撲克牌。

sentence: Suddenly the lights went off and it was dark.
trans: 突然燈熄滅了，四周一片漆黑。

sentence: I want to play soccer with you too.
trans: 我也想跟你們一起踢足球。

sentence: It is rude to interrupt others when they are talking.
trans: 別人在說話時插嘴是不禮貌的。

sentence: Keep your bedroom clean and tidy every day.
trans: 每天保持你的房間乾淨整齊。

sentence: We saw playful monkeys and tall giraffes at the zoo.
trans: 我們在動物園看到了頑皮的猴子和高大的長頸鹿。

sentence: Use paper glue to stick the pictures onto the card.
trans: 用膠水把圖片黏在卡片上。

sentence: Dinner will be ready very soon.
trans: 晚餐很快就會準備好了。

sentence: A cool breeze made the hot summer day pleasant.
trans: 一陣涼爽的微風讓炎熱的夏日變得舒適宜人。

sentence: The full moon shone brightly in the dark night sky.
trans: 滿月在漆黑的夜空中發出明亮的光芒。

sentence: Healthy food gives our bodies lots of energy.
trans: 健康的食物給我們的身體滿滿的能量。

sentence: We love to splash and swim in the cool pool on sunny days.
trans: 在晴天我們喜歡在涼爽的泳池裡玩水游泳。

sentence: The green snake slithered quietly through the tall grass.
trans: 綠色的小蛇安靜地在長草叢中滑行。

sentence: We bought fresh milk and eggs at the corner store.
trans: 我們在轉角的商店買了新鮮牛奶和雞蛋。

sentence: Put on your roller skates and meet me at the park.
trans: 穿上你的溜冰鞋，到公園跟我會合吧。

sentence: Children take turns going down the playground slide.
trans: 孩子們輪流從遊樂場的溜滑梯上溜下來。

sentence: White smoke rose slowly from the hot soup bowl.
trans: 白煙從熱湯碗中緩緩升起。

sentence: Push me higher on the playground swing, please!
trans: 請幫我把遊樂場的鞦韆推高一點！

sentence: Draw a big blue square on the drawing paper.
trans: 在圖畫紙上畫一個藍色的大正方形。

sentence: Eat your morning oatmeal with a clean spoon.
trans: 用乾淨的湯匙吃你的早晨燕麥粥。

sentence: Sudden loud noises can scare little puppies.
trans: 突如其來的巨大聲響會嚇到小狗。

sentence: A black and white skunk can spray a smelly scent.
trans: 黑白相間的臭鼬能噴出難聞的氣味。
